name: Byblos
description: Byblos, known locally as Jbeil, is a Mediterranean port town north of Beirut in Lebanon and one of the oldest cities in the world. People may have settled here as early as 8800 BC, and it has been lived in continuously since about 5000 BC. Walking its ruins, you pass the remains of Phoenician, Roman and later civilizations, and you can trace the roots of the Phoenician alphabet.
